chart.title: Share of plastic waste that is recycled, landfilled, incinerated and mismanaged
chart.subtitle: Mismanaged plastic waste includes materials burned in open pits, dumped into seas or open waters, or disposed of in unsanitary landfills and dumpsites.
chart.note: Regional aggregates were calculated by Our World in Data and are based on those specified by the OECD.
